dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.answer: Structural normative model repository (~58k subjects); Functional normative model multi-site dataset (~40 sites, overall 21,594 HC across train/test); HCP Young Adult; COBRE; UMich SchizGaze; OpenNeuro ds000243/ds002843/ds003798 transfer sets
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Structural cortical thickness/surface area/subcortical volume models from prior repository (~58,000 subjects across lifespan); Functional connectivity models trained/tested on 40-site healthy multi-site dataset (train 14,473; test 7,121; total 21,594) listed in Supplementary file 1; Benchmark datasets: HCP Young Adult; COBRE schizophrenia study; University of Michigan SchizGaze; Additional transfer datasets from OpenNeuro (ds000243, ds002843, ds003798)

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.answer: Structural repository for normative training; Functional multi-site dataset for normative training/testing; HCP for regression benchmark (also partly in functional train/test); COBRE and UMich as transfer sets for classification/group difference; OpenNeuro ds000243/ds002843/ds003798 as additional transfer sets
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Pre-trained structural models (cortical thickness/surface area/volume) supply normative reference; Functional multi-site healthy sample used to train (80%) and test (20%) functional normative models; HCP included in functional training/testing and used in regression benchmarking to predict cognition; COBRE and UMich not seen in training, used as transfer sites for generating deviation scores and for schizophrenia vs control classification and group-difference benchmarks; OpenNeuro ds000243/ds002843/ds003798 used solely as held-out transfer datasets to demonstrate generalization
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "For the structural data, we used a publicly shared repository of pre-  trained normative models..."; "Functional normative models were trained on a large multi- site dataset (approx. N=22,000)... Evaluation ... in a test set (20% of the training set) and in two transfer sets ..."; "HCP was included in the initial training (half of the sample was held out in the test set), while the UMich and COBRE datasets were not included in the training and can be considered as examples of transfer to new, unseen sites"; "The HCP data was used in the prediction - regression benchmarking task. The COBRE and UMich datasets are used in the classification and group difference testing benchmarking tasks"; "leveraged three datasets (ds000243, ds002843, ds003798) from OpenNeuro.org to create a multi- site transfer dataset"
